name: Stripe
tagline: Powerful but sprawling — activation, test mode, API keys, first payment.
firstWin: your dashboard in test mode with your API keys located
path: sign in or create an account
confirm you're in Test mode (toggle, top right)
open the Developers → API keys page
note the publishable + secret test keys
explore the Payments tab where charges will appear
optional: Activating live payments needs business details; that can wait until after they've tested.

knowledge.text: The Test mode toggle is top-right. In test mode no real money moves and you use test card 4242 4242 4242 4242. Live mode needs account activation with business details.
API keys are under Developers → API keys. The publishable key (pk_) goes in client code; the secret key (sk_) must stay on your server.
Use card number 4242 4242 4242 4242 with any future expiry and any CVC to create a successful test payment.
